exposure: Antenatal ultrasound diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
Intraoperative clinical grading of PAS using FIGO 2018 criteria
outcome: Agreement between antenatal ultrasound and intraoperative PAS grading
Agreement between intraoperative PAS grading and histopathological findings
cohort: 70 pregnant women with placenta previa suspected of having Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who were managed at an accredited PAS Center.
finding: Antenatal ultrasound diagnoses and intraoperative clinical grading of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) demonstrated substantial concordance (kappa=0.88), while the agreement between intraoperative grading and histopathology was moderate (kappa=0.68).
